headline: Quiet day; scores hold their ground
body: Another day without scored events. The only change came from older stories fading, worth a few hundredths here and there. Horizon Balance stays at -2.62. Enslaved God leads at 36.84, followed by Libertarian Utopia at 25.16 and 1984 at 24.62.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Protector God -0.05.
